Type: deco
Name: Amazon Brand - Rivet Modern Cutout Hanging Mirror, 23"H, Gold
Colors: Brass
Materials: metal
This stunning oval cutout mirror with its modern take on simplicity and grace is a beautiful addition to any home. Spruce up your living space with some functional modern art and enjoy the results. 23"H x 10"W x 1.25"D Mirrored glass with a gold finished metal frame Can be used as a standard mirror or an accent piece This elegant work of modern craftsmanship is 100% handmade and hand painted. Avoid moisture and wipe clean with a soft, dry cloth. Hardware not included.
